decisions.reason: As a close extension of the core cheese range that survived the first post-launch screening, it likely has low carrying costs and still supports the firm's narrow portfolio, so keeping the option is more valuable than dropping it now.

Because this spicy cheese became a small line with several variants and remained visible after launch, it appears to have earned a place in the core offer, making continuation more likely despite some portfolio complexity.

This mild creamy soft cheese fits the established business and organic brand well, but after several years the uncertainty around its value is more resolved, so it is somewhat more exposed to pruning if sales are only average.
